discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: After quantum-circuit (2025), machine-learning (2024) and attosecond (2023) prizes, a condensed-matter discovery with long-established foundational status is well positioned. Topological insulators reshaped condensed matter physics: Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state (2005) and Molenkamp's group observed it in HgTe quantum wells (2007). The field is mature, widely cited, and all three are living. Shoucheng Zhang's death removes a natural co-laureate and makes this trio cleaner.
